title: Open Mic Night
description: Leo loves playing acoustic guitar alone in his room, but performing live in front of strangers tests his courage.

scenes.narration: I have played acoustic guitar in my bedroom for three years, hidden away where nobody could hear me play a wrong chord.
scenes.visual: Teen boy sitting on the edge of a bed playing an acoustic guitar in a cozy bedroom

scenes.narration: When my best friend signed me up for an open-mic night, my stomach immediately dropped into a heavy knot.
scenes.visual: Teen boy holding an acoustic guitar looking shocked at his friend who is smiling

scenes.narration: Standing behind the dark velvet curtain, listening to the announcer call my name, my fingers went completely numb.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a nervous teen boy looking out from behind a dark stage curtain into dim lights

scenes.narration: I walked out, sat on the stool, and froze. The first chord came out buzzing and totally out of tune.
scenes.visual: Teen boy sitting on a stage stool under a warm spotlight holding a guitar with an anxious face

scenes.narration: I took a deep breath, tuned the string, and started over. I closed my eyes and imagined I was back in my quiet bedroom.
scenes.visual: Close-up of boy closing his eyes peacefully while resting his fingers on guitar strings

scenes.narration: By the second verse, my fingers took over. When I finished, the polite applause felt louder than a stadium crowd.
scenes.visual: Teen boy smiling softly under stage lights while holding his acoustic guitar after finishing a song

scenes.narration: Facing your fears never gets easy, but the feeling afterward is worth every second. Follow along for more stories like this!
scenes.visual: Teen boy resting his guitar against a wall and smiling genuinely into the camera

character_reference: A slender young adult human with messy dark brown hair, wearing a casual blue denim jacket over a plain grey t-shirt and black jeans. They feature a small silver hoop earring in their left ear and a thin woven hemp bracelet on their right wrist.
